deadEnd.details: The flight search results page (/flights/search/) is behind a Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' page with an interactive Turnstile 'Verify you are human' checkbox, both from the homepage search form and from a deep link. The homepage itself loads without a challenge.

gotchas: Homepage https://www.airasia.com/en/gb loads with a cookie banner (dismiss via its close icon); the browser egress geolocates the 'From' box to the nearest airports.

Search form: click 'One way', then the From and To textboxes are plain inputs with no stable id; type an IATA code (e.g. KUL, PEN) and click the airport row in the suggestion list, then pick a day in the calendar and click Done, then Search.
The homepage re-renders often and is heavy: accessibility snapshots time out intermittently (retry after a few seconds) and aria refs go stale between calls.

Search deep link: https://www.airasia.com/flights/search/?origin=KUL&destination=PEN&departDate=DD%2FMM%2FYYYY&tripType=O&adult=1&child=0&infant=0&locale=en-gb&currency=MYR&cabinClass=economy - it lands on the same Cloudflare Turnstile wall.
From the homepage form, Search leaves a blank page with a spinner that never resolves (results never render).
